description: This file defines ASN.1 XNAP protocol structures, including message types, procedures, and classes for encoding/decoding ASN.1 messages related to 3GPP TS ASN1 XNAP specifications.

classes.name: xnap::init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 InitiatingMessage with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: xnap::successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 SuccessfulOutcome with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: xnap::unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 UnsuccessfulOutcome with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Defines the set of ASN.1 elementary procedures, including nested classes for different procedure categories.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_class_1_o
classes.description: Defines ASN.1 procedures for class 1, including various request and response message types.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_class_2_o
classes.description: Defines ASN.1 procedures for class 2, including additional message types.

classes.name: xnap::xn_ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 XNAP Protocol Data Unit as a choice of message types.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads object information based on procedure code.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type for ASN.1 message structures.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into ASN.1 bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes ASN.1 bit stream into message structure.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message structure to JSON format.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Cleans up the ASN.1 message choice object.
